name: Rozen Maiden
source:
Anime story is relayed to mobile phones. If game is finished with good results, there is also an original after-story scenario.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作将动画的故事搬到了手机上。如果以较好的成绩完成游戏，还能体验一段原创的后日谈剧情。

（摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]）
